title: NeetCode Trainer - FAANG & Google Interview Simulator
description: Interactive technical interview training suite featuring a zero-autocomplete Google Doc mode Python pad, phase-aware 35-minute countdown clock, in-browser WebAssembly Python execution, and zero-trust Google Cloud Firestore synchronization across devices.
highlights: Zero-autocomplete 'Google Doc Mode' coding environment to build authentic syntax recall for technical screens
Phase-aware 35-minute interview timer guiding through Clarification, Brute Force, Optimization, Code, and Dry Run
In-browser Python 3 execution sandbox powered by Pyodide WebAssembly with unit and edge-case assertions
Interactive Variable Trace Scratchpad to dry-run test cases line-by-line before submitting code
Zero-trust cross-device sync powered by Firebase Google OAuth 2.0 and strict partition Firestore security rules
Automated spaced repetition review scheduler calculating recall intervals with 1-click Google Sheets TSV export

title: CozyCart - Zero-Knowledge Shared Shopping & Local Aisle Sorting
description: Shared household grocery static web application featuring client-side AES-256-GCM zero-knowledge encryption, local multilingual aisle sorting (14.6 KB on-device taxonomy), and plain-text Notes app interoperability with zero accounts or central tracking.
highlights: Client-side PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (210,000 iter) + AES-256-GCM zero-knowledge encryption via URL fragment capabilities (#join=)
Conflict-free optimistic Firestore transaction syncing powered by a deterministic LWW-Element-Set CRDT
On-device 14.6 KB Open Food Facts taxonomy (2,563 terms, 9 languages) with Fuse.js fuzzy matching and encrypted household learning
1-tap bidirectional Notes app sync (Apple Notes, Google Keep, markdown checklists) with automatic quantity/unit parsing
Human-crafted Botanical Market Ledger aesthetic with Instrument Serif typography and 12 culinary aisle palettes

title: Pulse Bot - Market Scanner & Discord Alerts
description: An automated daily scanner built in pure Python that tracks market trends, checks news headlines with Gemini to spot sudden company risks, and sends structured summary cards to Discord via webhooks before the market opens.
highlights: Built with pure Python standard library and zero third-party package dependencies
Uses Gemini to scan recent news headlines and flag sudden events (profit warnings, unexpected news)
Formats and sends structured, color-coded daily summary cards to Discord via webhooks
Runs automatically every weekday morning on GitHub Actions with automated state tracking

title: TDD & Prompt Engineering Research
description: Degree research exploring how AI prompt engineering can assist developers in writing unit tests, structuring test cases, and adopting Test-Driven Development (TDD).
highlights: Empirical study on prompt design patterns for automated unit test generation
Co-authored thesis at Blekinge Institute of Technology (BTH)
Published and archived in the Swedish academic DiVA portal

title: CloudVault - Secure File Storage & Sharing
description: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage platform with instant shareable links, version history, and role-based workspace permissions.
highlights: Client-side encryption using AES-GCM and Web Crypto API
Chunked multi-part upload engine handling large files
Granular file permission management and expiring share links

title: DevFlow - CLI Task & Workflow Automator
description: A developer-first command-line tool to automate project scaffolding, git hooks, environment configurations, and continuous delivery.
highlights: Automates repetitive development setup and environment initialization
Cross-platform support and minimal dependency footprint
Extensible declarative YAML configuration system

title: ZenNote - Offline-First Markdown Studio
description: Distraction-free markdown editor with live split-screen preview, LaTeX math typesetting, and local synchronization.
highlights: 100% offline functionality as an installable Progressive Web App
Instant export to PDF, HTML, and presentation formats
Built with vanilla web standards and local IndexedDB caching
